description: This file implements string splitting utilities, including functions for splitting strings by delimiters, trimming whitespace, and handling key-value pairs, with support for both ASCII and UTF-16 encodings.

methods.name: WhitespaceForType
methods.description: Template function returning whitespace characters for ASCII or UTF-16 types.

methods.name: FindFirstOf
methods.description: Overloaded functions to find the first occurrence of a character or string in a string view.

methods.name: SplitStringT
methods.description: Template function that splits a string view into a vector of substrings based on delimiters.

methods.name: AppendStringKeyValue
methods.description: Function to parse a key-value pair from a string and append it to a result vector.

methods.name: SplitStringUsingSubstrT
methods.description: Template function to split a string view into substrings based on a delimiter, using substrings.
